comment: Documented WHMP/WHA/WHSV action lines extracted from public PDFs. Used as B1 baseline for case airports.

SEA.name: Seattle-Tacoma International Airport
SEA.document: SEA Wildlife Hazard Management Plan (Appendix 1 of the SEA Airport Certification Manual), 28 March 2022, FAA-approved 29 March 2022

lines.text: Zero-tolerance wildlife control on the airfield for hazardous species
European starling live-trapping and control; rock pigeon trapping
Raptor Strike Avoidance Program: trap, mark, and translocate raptors
Clear and maintain ditches throughout airfield to enhance drainage
Cover stormwater and industrial wastewater/glycol ponds with netting and floating balls
Coyote-deterrent AOA perimeter fence with buried fabric
Cut airfield grass more frequently; coordinate City of SeaTac mowing
End Tyee Valley Golf Course lease; convert to shrub-scrub
Trash, debris, and handouts control (prey-base management)
Convert Lora Lake and adjacent open water to shrub-scrub habitat

BJJ.name: Wayne County Airport (Smithville, Ohio)
BJJ.document: Wildlife Hazard Assessment Final Report, Wayne County Airport, December 2014 (CHA 27243)

lines.text: Zero-tolerance policy: immediate harassment of deer, coyotes, geese, raptors, starlings, blackbirds
Lethal reinforcement with depredation permits when required
Mow at least monthly in growing season; target height 7-10 inches
Replace grain crops with hay; early harvest; no no-till residue
Perimeter wildlife fence not currently justified; install only if deer/coyote AOA use increases

GIF.name: Winter Haven Gilbert Airport
GIF.document: Winter Haven Gilbert Airport Wildlife Hazard Site Visit, 6 November 2018

lines.text: Repair AOA exclusion gate gaps to less than 6 inches; grate openings
Turf management; avoid ruts that pond water when mowing wet areas
Drain standing stormwater; detention ponds to empty within 48 hours
Six surrounding lakes/waterbodies as waterfowl attractants in approach airspace

0B5.name: Turners Falls Municipal Airport
0B5.document: Wildlife Hazard Management Plan, Turners Falls Municipal Airport (0B5), 14 July 2022, Stantec

lines.text: Fence for large mammal control; inspect fence and gates
Maintain grass height 2-10 inches; mowing plan for sandplain grasslands
Pyrotechnic devices to harass Canada geese; proactive harassment
Lethal action when necessary; take Canada geese under permit
Exclude waterfowl from Green Pond and Lake Pleasant with water department
